summary: Bruker Corporation filed an 8-K solely to declare a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.05 per share on common stock, payable July 7, 2026 to holders of record June 22, 2026. There is no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation event described. The filing is a standard dividend declaration under Item 8.01. No deal terms apply. The event is purely an ordinary course dividend and does not constitute a special situation.
